  .interop-header { text-align:center; margin-bottom:28px; }
  .interop-badge {
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,#FF6B2C,#FFB800);

  /* Schéma visuel */
  .interop-schema {

  }
  .interop-side { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; }

  .interop-node {

  .interop-confirm {
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    font-size:.78rem; font-weight:600; color:#00996e;
    background:rgba(0,200,150,.08); border-radius:8px;
    padding:7px 11px; animation:fadeInUp .4s ease both;

  .interop-confirm--2 { color:#090C9F; background:rgba(9,12,159,.06); animation-delay:.2s; }
  .interop-confirm i { font-size:.85rem; }
  @keyframes fadeInUp {
    from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px); }
    to   { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }

  /* Groupes côté vendeur */
  .interop-group {
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px;
  }
  .interop-group-label {
    font-size:.65rem; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.07em; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:6px;
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px;
    margin-bottom:2px; align-self:flex-start;
  }
  .interop-group-label--instant {
    background:rgba(0,200,150,.1); color:#00896a;
  }
  .interop-group-label--bank {
    background:rgba(9,12,159,.07); color:#090C9F;
  }
  .interop-group-divider {
    border:none; border-top:1px dashed rgba(9,12,159,.12);
    margin:6px 0;
  }
  /* Tags mobiles */
  .interop-tags {
    display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px;
    justify-content:center; margin-top:16px;
  }
  .itag {
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px;
    font-size:.72rem; font-weight:600; border-radius:20px;
    padding:4px 10px; border:1px solid transparent;
  }
  .itag--orange { background:rgba(255,107,44,.1); color:#c94f10; border-color:rgba(255,107,44,.25); }
  .itag--mtn    { background:rgba(255,203,5,.12);  color:#a07b00; border-color:rgba(255,203,5,.4); }
  .itag--airtel { background:rgba(220,30,30,.08);  color:#b01010; border-color:rgba(220,30,30,.2); }
  .itag--wave   { background:rgba(0,168,240,.1);   color:#006fa6; border-color:rgba(0,168,240,.25); }
  .itag--visa   { background:rgba(26,31,113,.08);  color:#1A1F71; border-color:rgba(26,31,113,.2); }
  @media(max-width:600px){
    .interop-schema { flex-direction:column; }
    .interop-arrows-wrap { width:100%; height:30px; transform:rotate(90deg); }
    .interop-center { flex-direction:row; }
    .interop-standalone-section { padding:40px 0 36px; }
  }

      box-shadow: 0 32px 96px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);

      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;

        <!-- ÉTAPE 1 : Profil -->

            <div class="ely-field">
              <label class="ely-label" id="rm-l-ln">Nom</label>

            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="ely-field">

          <div class="ely-form-nav">
            <button type="button" class="ely-btn-next" onclick="rmGoStep(2)">

            </button>

          <input type="text" id="rm-otp-code" class="ely-otp-input" maxlength="6" placeholder="000000" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code">
          <div class="ely-otp-error" id="rm-otp-error">
            <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
            <span id="rm-otp-error-text"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="ely-otp-success-msg" id="rm-otp-resent">
            <i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i>
            <span id="rm-otp-resent-text">Code renvoyé !</span>
          </div>
          <div class="ely-otp-actions">
            <button type="button" class="ely-btn-submit" id="rm-otp-btn" onclick="rmVerifyOtp()">
              <div class="ely-spinner" id="rm-otp-spinner"></div>
              <i class="fas fa-check-circle" id="rm-otp-btn-icon"></i>
              <span id="rm-otp-btn-label">Vérifier le code</span>
            </button>
            <div class="ely-otp-links">
              <button type="button" class="ely-otp-link" id="rm-otp-resend" onclick="rmResendCode()">

                <option value="FREELANCE" id="rm-type-free">💼 Freelance</option>
                <option value="BUS_TRANSPORTATION" id="rm-type-bus">🚌 Transport Bus</option>
                <option value="ASSOCIATION" id="rm-type-train">🤝 Association</option>
                <option value="SPORTS" id="rm-type-sports">⚽ Sports</option>
                <option value="BEAUTY" id="rm-type-beauty">💅 Soins / Beauté</option>
                <option value="HEALTH" id="rm-type-health">🏥 Santé / Paramédical</option>
                <option value="EDUCATION" id="rm-type-edu">📚 Enseignement</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="ely-field">
            <label class="ely-label" id="rm-l-country">Pays d'activité</label>
            <div class="ely-input-wrap">
              <i class="fas fa-globe-africa ely-input-icon"></i>
              <select id="rm-country" class="ely-input" onchange="rmUpdateCurrency()">
                <option value="" id="rm-cnt-ph">-- Sélectionner --</option>
                <option value="CM|Cameroun|XAF">🇨🇲 Cameroun</option>

                <option value="CD|RD Congo|CDF">🇨🇩 RD Congo</option>
                <option value="NG|Nigeria|NGN">🇳🇬 Nigeria</option>
                <option value="GH|Ghana|GHS">🇬🇭 Ghana</option>
                <option value="SN|Sénégal|XOF">🇸🇳 Sénégal</option>
                <option value="MA|Maroc|MAD">🇲🇦 Maroc</option>
                <option value="FR|France|EUR">🇫🇷 France</option>
                <option value="BE|Belgique|EUR">🇧🇪 Belgique</option>
                <option value="CH|Suisse|CHF">🇨🇭 Suisse</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="ely-field">
            <label class="ely-label" id="rm-l-city">Ville</label>

              <i class="fas fa-city ely-input-icon"></i>

          </div>
          <div class="ely-field">
            <label class="ely-label" id="rm-l-address">Adresse</label>

          <div class="ely-form-nav">

              <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i> <span id="rm-back2">Retour</span>

            <button type="button" class="ely-btn-next" onclick="rmGoStep(3)">
              <span id="rm-next2">Continuer</span> <i class="fas fa-arrow-right"></i>

        </div>

    </div>

  <div id="elyForgotOverlay" class="ely-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Mot de passe oublié">
    <div class="ely-forgot-box">

        <i class="fas fa-times"></i>
      </button>

      <!-- Formulaire principal -->
      <div id="ely-forgot-form-wrap">
        <div class="ely-forgot-icon"><i class="fas fa-lock-open"></i></div>
        <h2 id="ely-forgot-title">Mot de passe oublié ?</h2>
        <p class="ely-forgot-sub" id="ely-forgot-sub">
          Saisissez votre adresse e-mail et nous vous enverrons un lien pour réinitialiser votre mot de passe.
        </p>

        <!-- Champ email -->
        <div class="ely-field">
          <label class="ely-label" id="ely-forgot-lbl">Adresse e-mail</label>
          <div class="ely-input-wrap">
            <i class="fas fa-envelope ely-input-icon"></i>
            <input type="email" id="ely-forgot-email" class="ely-input" placeholder="vous@exemple.com" autocomplete="email">
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Erreur -->
        <div class="ely-error" id="ely-forgot-error" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
          <i class="fas fa-exclamation-circle"></i>
          <span id="ely-forgot-error-txt">Une erreur est survenue.</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Bouton envoyer -->
        <button class="ely-btn-submit" id="ely-forgot-btn" onclick="handleForgotModal()">
          <div class="ely-spinner" id="ely-forgot-spinner"></div>
          <i class="fas fa-paper-plane" id="ely-forgot-btn-icon"></i>
          <span id="ely-forgot-btn-label">Envoyer le lien</span>
        </button>

        <!-- Retour connexion -->
        <button class="ely-back-link" onclick="closeForgotModal();openLoginModal();">
          <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
          <span id="ely-forgot-back">Retour à la connexion</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <!-- Écran succès -->
      <div class="ely-forgot-success" id="ely-forgot-success-wrap">
        <div class="check-circle">
          <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <h2 id="ely-forgot-ok-title" style="font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:8px;">E-mail envoyé !</h2>
        <p id="ely-forgot-ok-msg" style="color:#6b7494;font-size:0.88rem;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:24px;">
          Vérifiez votre boîte mail et cliquez sur le lien reçu pour réinitialiser votre mot de passe.
        </p>
        <p style="color:#9ca3af;font-size:0.78rem;margin-bottom:20px;" id="ely-forgot-ok-spam">
          Pensez à vérifier vos spams si vous ne recevez rien dans 2 minutes.
        </p>
        <button class="ely-back-link" onclick="closeForgotModal();openLoginModal();">
          <i class="fas fa-arrow-left"></i>
          <span id="ely-forgot-ok-back">Retour à la connexion</span>
        </button>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
  </div></body></html>
